I could not find written proof that Andy Bracey ever gave us permission to use this image, and it doesn't help that they have removed it from their Flickr account. I have since removed the image from the article and contacted Bracey with permission from ProcyonLotor. Until they contact me or any other staff member back, the image will stay down.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This feels like a very interesting start to an article, but needs to be fleshed out a bit. Some types of articles work very well by keeping them brief, and some need much more detail to work. This is definitely the latter type. Right now, it's just a place where electronic noise comes from, with an immortal human who has no other purpose. The rest of the article doesn't really do much to add to that, and feels sort of tacked on. Either it's unnecessary, or doesn't contain enough information on why it's necessary. Others have complained about the big bold removed big, and I think that's a large part of the problem; but all the redactions and missing bits just kill it for me. I'd like to know more about 900-1 and why she can't be removed. I'd like to know more about the noise, and why it matters. I'd like to know more about the relationships between the various bits. And, of course, redactions in the containment procedures are always a bad idea.

There are some good bits, so I'm not voting it down, just remaining neutral.
